$meta.readThisFirst: TWO token names bound by these components do NOT exist in the owner's 2026-08-24 Agency/Primitives export, which is the input authority: (1) control/height-default = 30 — live Figma returns it, the export has no control/* group at all; (2) fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0 — live Figma returns it, the export ships fonts/tracking/tracking-0 without the legacy X- prefix. Neither is usable as a binding until the export is refreshed and the design owner confirms. Every geometry value they would have covered is recorded RAW here, deliberately, rather than claiming a token the authority cannot back.

families.name: inline
families.usage: Displayed in place of content when no data is available — empty tables, missing field information, blank calendars, or any view where records have not yet been added. Figma component description, read 2026-08-25.

families.name: popup
families.usage: Non-dismissible modal shown when required data must be filled before the user can proceed. Remains visible until the user acts via a provided button. Figma component description, read 2026-08-25.

anatomy.note: Two independent component sets sharing a visual language, NOT one set with a variant axis. They differ in three measured respects — container gap, heading colour, and primary-action colour — documented under variantAxes.familyDifferences.

maxWidth.note: Unbound. Same 800 appears on the popup family — a shared intent with no token behind it.

frameWidth.note: The Figma frame width, i.e. layout context, NOT a component constraint. Do not hardcode it; the component is fluid between minWidth and maxWidth.

gap.note: 16, NOT the inline family's 24. A measured difference between the two families, not an error.

background.note: Popups are always white — there is no grey background axis on this family.

containerPadding.note: Emitted as a raw 4px, NOT bound to spacing/sm even though spacing/sm = 4 exists in the export.

glyphSize.note: GEOMETRIC INCONSISTENCY: a 48px box with 4px padding leaves a 40px content area, but the glyph is 46px — it overflows its own padding by 6px. Recorded as measured; see defects.

actionButtons.note: Buttons inside both families reuse the Button component. Only what these empty states actually bind is recorded here; the full button contract is authoritative for everything else.

minHeight.note: Emitted RAW in every button across all 11 variants. A candidate token control/height-default = 30 IS returned by live Figma for this frame but does NOT exist in the owner's 2026-08-24 export — so it cannot be cited as a binding yet. This is the same gap the Button contract records, and it is a BINDING gap rather than a missing-token gap if the export refresh confirms the token. Blocked pending the design owner.

fixedWidths.note: Fixed widths on individual buttons alongside a min-width. Recorded because they are real; flagged in defects because a fixed width can clip a translated or user-enlarged label.

headingWidth.note: DERIVED, not a design decision. It is the content width that falls out of the frame width; it must not be reproduced as a fixed value in code.

letterSpacing.note: Figma reports -0.23999999463558197; the export's primitive is tracking-neg-024. Treat as -0.24.

Live Figma binds fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0. The X- prefix marks a LEGACY token and that exact name is absent from the owner's export, which ships fonts/tracking/tracking-0 instead. Recorded RAW because the bound name has no backing in the authority. Replace with the non-prefixed token once the design owner confirms they are the same value.

colourFormula.pattern: Background switches on the `background` axis; all text is a text/* token; icons are icon/* tokens; actions follow the Button contract's action/{type}/{role} pattern.

popupHeadingColour.note: text/primary, NOT the inline family's text/secondary. A real measured difference between families.

alphaIsLoadBearing.warning: The popup family's shadow-lg effect is two drop shadows whose colours both carry alpha below 1: #0000000D (5%) and #0000001A (10%). A pipeline that reads only the hex field and discards alpha renders both as solid black, turning a soft elevation into two hard black bars.

namingException.detail: The filled 'Add New' button binds action/success/bg for its background but action/primary/text-neutral for its label. The Button contract's formula says a filled button of type T uses action/T/text-neutral, so this should be action/success/text-neutral. Both resolve to white, so there is NO visual defect — but a code generator built on the formula will emit the wrong token name here.
namingException.impact: Do not infer the label token from the background token for this button.

variantAxes.unresolved: The same button, with the same label 'Add New', is GREEN in the inline family and BLUE in the popup family. Both are measured and correct as drawn. Which is intended is a design-owner decision, not something this contract resolves.

states.name: Search
states.heading: No Record(s) Found.
defects: grey variant heading is not token-bound — see defects list

nonDismissibleModal.concern: Figma's own description states the popup family is non-dismissible and remains visible until the user acts. A modal with no escape route conflicts with the expectation that a user can always dismiss or defer a dialog, and needs an explicit accessible path — a focus trap with no exit is a known barrier.
nonDismissibleModal.status: RAISED, NOT RESOLVED — needs the design owner's ruling on whether Escape/close must be provided.

iconMeaning.concern: Search uses the warning glyph and Good News uses info. In both, colour plus glyph carry the meaning while the heading text repeats it, so meaning is not conveyed by colour alone.
iconMeaning.status: PASSES the never-colour-alone rule on inspection of the measured structure.

headingSemantics.concern: Figma draws the heading with the Heading/h4 text style. Whether it should be a real heading element in the accessibility tree, and at what level, is not something Figma records.
headingSemantics.status: UNVERIFIED — implementation decision, not measurable from the design.

fixedButtonWidth.concern: The inline 'Add New' button carries a fixed 100px width and the popup ghost button 84px, alongside min-width. Fixed-width text containers can clip a longer translation or user-enlarged text.

accessibility.contrastNotMeasured: No contrast ratios were computed for this contract. The token pairings are recorded so they can be checked, but the check was not run.

defects: Search / grey variant (10682:19314): the heading is NOT token-bound. Its parent carries text-[0px] and leading-[0], and the visible text is three child spans each hardcoding #475569, 18px, 24px line-height and -0.24px tracking. The white sibling (12428:28274) binds the same values through tokens correctly. So one variant of one state bypasses the token layer entirely — a code generator copying the grey variant would emit raw hex.
Icon geometry: 48px container with 4px padding gives a 40px content box, but the glyph is 46px — a 6px overflow of its own padding. Present on both icon-bearing states.

Filled 'Add New' in inline First Time mixes namespaces: background action/success/bg with label action/primary/text-neutral. No visual defect (both are white) but it breaks the action/{type}/{role} formula.
Same-label colour divergence: 'Add New' is green (action/success/bg) inline and blue (action/primary/bg) in the popup family.
Fixed widths alongside min-width: 100px on the inline filled button, 84px on the popup ghost button.
Container padding of 4px on the icon block is emitted raw rather than bound to spacing/sm, which exists in the export at the same value.

Popup shadow has two conflicting descriptions in one Figma payload: the effect metadata gives radius 6 spread -2 and radius 15 spread -3, while the generated CSS approximates them as 3px and 7.5px blur with no spread. The effect metadata is authoritative; the generated approximation must not be copied.

Body copy in all 8 inline variants is the identical placeholder string 'Create a new file or import from your existing tools to start collaborating with your team.' The popup copy references downloading a 'repertory' (probably 'repository'), pull requests and code review. This is developer-tool placeholder text, not home-care product copy — content, not design, but it will ship as-is if nobody replaces it.

openTokenDecision.gate: Design-owner approval required before either name may be used as a binding.
openTokenDecision.proposal: 1) Refresh the Agency export from Figma so control/height-default (=30) either appears or is confirmed absent; if it appears, the button min-height across this and the Button contract becomes a binding fix rather than a new-token request. 2) Confirm whether fonts/tracking/X-tracking-0 in live Figma is the same value as fonts/tracking/tracking-0 in the export, and if so retire the X- prefixed name in Figma.
openTokenDecision.untilApproved: Every affected value is published RAW in this contract. Recording a RAW value is NOT permission to hardcode it in shipped CSS.

Contrast ratios for every token pairing recorded above — pairings captured, ratios not computed.
